summary: 26-year-old Ski & Snowboard Club Vail coach skiing off-piste with a friend in the East Vail Chutes sidecountry followed his companion over a cliff band and was killed; seven Vail ski patrollers worked over several hours in darkness rigging multiple rappels to recover the body and hand it off to first responders (the 11th snowsports fatality in East Vail since 1986)
location: East Vail Chutes, Vail Mountain sidecountry
responding_agency: Vail Ski Patrol (7 patrollers); Vail Mountain Rescue Group on-call coordinator served as county SAR coordinator on the 911 call
notes: First-person account by the VMRG K9 Technical Lead who was the county SAR coordinator on duty (Vail-Beaver Creek Magazine, Nov 2023); deceased's name not given in source; fills thin year 2023 for Eagle
